scope: Every file shipped from public; source/research archives are not browser downloads and remain untouched. Existing portable-guide preview images are a separately published artifact, not the game-quality baseline.
policy: No resizing, quantization, near-lossless, chroma changes or quality reduction. Keep original unless same-format candidate is smaller with identical full decoded RGBA (including invisible RGB) and identical color/orientation metadata. Audit does not modify originals.
